en-US.name: Fluent Scrobbler
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fluent Scrobbler — 1.3 Release Notes (2026-11-05)
Fluent Scrobbler 1.3 brings powerful filtering tools to tailor your scrobble history, introducing temporary track ignores, permanent artist and track blocking, and a quick-access system tray flyout.
New Features
- Quick Tray flyout: Added an optional interactive flyout accessible right from the system tray icon. View current playback status and quickly like, ignore, or block tracks without opening the main window. (Enabled by default; can be toggled in Settings > Enable tray quick flyout).
- Permanent artist and track blocking: Block unwanted artists or tracks to permanently prevent them from scrobbling. Manage and unblock items at any time under Settings > Source & Track filtering > Blocked items.
- Temporary track ignore: Introduced an "Ignore" action (minus circle icon) to skip scrobbling the current playing track for the active session without creating a permanent block rule.
Enhancements
- Streamlined dashboard architecture: Consolidated track-specific controls exclusively into the Scrobbles view, resolving state and cache synchronization issues across pages.
- Performance and stability: General internal optimizations and polish for smoother background operations.
Bug Reports & Support
Despite our best efforts to ensure a polished release, bugs may occasionally occur. If you encounter any issues, please open a bug report here.
